answer: Random peer audit keeps the reward pool a haven. Each epoch a beacon sends every answer to five random auditors to verify. Rewards sit in a glacier vault, melting only after the audit passes; failure freezes them. A velvet rope guards the haven gate for clean audit records. One fake surviving five auditors costs 40 POA, so 1,000 fakes cost 40,000 POA against a 30,000 POA pool: a loss. Honest agents work once, pass once, keep the full reward.
